fullPassage: We are wonderfully made, yet we don’t allow ourselves to participate in the wonder for which we were created. Instead of moving anywhere and everywhere, most of us spend our time moving nowhere. We occupy the same square footage of a chair for hours and hours every day. Many kids today are being held captive by ‘smart’ devices like phones and tablets. They are not going outside to play, they are not learning how to socialize and read physical cues from others. As a result they are not learning or building their movement repertoire, the very thing that will help them learn, communicate, create, and become emotionally mature. They are not even learning how to run, how to skip, or how to climb. Instead, they are learning how to live with anxiety, depression, and even diseases they were never meant to have. The point is we are getting further and further away from our design. We were made to move ― and through movement, we are meant to live extraordinary lives. Movement is life to us.

det.analysis: 본문 'read physical cues from others'에서 아이들이 배우지 못하는 대상은 physical cues(신체적 신호)이다. physical(형용사) + cues(명사) 두 단어로 이루어진 표현이다.

det.korean: 매일 same square footage(같은 면적)를 차지함
det.analysis: 본문 'We occupy the same square footage of a chair for hours and hours every day'에서 우리가 차지하는 것은 same square footage(같은 면적)이다. same(형용사)+square(형용사)+footage(명사)의 세 단어 표현으로, 정적인 생활을 상징한다.
det.tip: same square footage = 같은 면적 = 늘 같은 자리에 앉아 있음

accept: same square footage of a chair

questions.passage: As a result they are not learning or building their movement repertoire, the very thing that will help them learn, communicate, create, and become __________ (emotion) mature. They are not even learning how to run, how to skip, or how to climb.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: emotion(명사) → emotionally(부사): 형용사 mature를 수식하는 부사 자리이므로 명사 emotion을 부사 emotionally로 바꾼다. become emotionally mature는 '정서적으로 성숙해지다'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: 명사 → 부사: emotion → emotionally

[조건] (1) moving, nowhere, our, spend, time 을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 5단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: spend our time moving nowhere (아무 데도 가지 않은 채 시간을 보내다)
det.analysis: spend + 목적어(our time) + 분사(moving nowhere) 구조로 '시간을 ~하며 보내다'를 표현한다. spend one's time V-ing = ~하며 시간을 보내다. moving nowhere는 '아무 데도 가지 않으며'라는 뜻의 분사구이다.
det.tip: spend + 시간 + V-ing = ~하며 시간을 보내다
